hero.title: A scientific method with a human heart
hero.subtitle: For over a decade, Raba Center has combined certified applied behavior analysis, speech therapy, and family-centered support to help children with developmental disorders build real, lasting skills.

mission.missionText: To give every child access to evidence-based developmental therapy delivered with dignity, and to equip families with the tools to support progress at home, not just in the clinic.
mission.visionText: A region where a developmental diagnosis is met with a clear path forward, not uncertainty — where specialized care is close, affordable, and genuinely effective.

team.title: The team behind every treatment plan

lead.name: Dr. Lama Al-Harbi
lead.bio: Dr. Lama has led applied behavior analysis programs for over 14 years, designing individualized treatment plans and supervising the center's clinical team to make sure every program stays evidence-based and measurable.

behavior.name: Omar Al-Sayed
behavior.bio: Omar specializes in functional behavior assessment and early-intervention ABA programs, working closely with families to translate clinical progress into everyday routines at home.

speech.name: Hind Al-Qahtani
speech.bio: Hind works with children on expressive and receptive language delays, using play-based therapy techniques that keep sessions engaging while building measurable communication milestones.

occupational.name: Yousef Al-Otaibi
occupational.bio: Yousef focuses on sensory processing and fine motor development, helping children build the physical foundations they need for daily independence and classroom readiness.

evidence.title: Evidence-based practice
evidence.description: Every program is built on peer-reviewed methods and tracked with measurable outcomes, not guesswork.

family.title: Family-centered care
family.description: Parents are treated as partners in treatment, with regular updates and take-home strategies, not passive observers.

compassion.title: Compassionate service
compassion.description: Every child is met with patience and respect for their pace — clinical rigor never comes at the cost of warmth.

growth.title: Continuous growth
growth.description: Our specialists pursue ongoing certification and training so our methods keep pace with the latest research.
